extraction.name: PASTIS
extraction.description: Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme Series (PASTIS) is the first open-access SITS dataset with panoptic annotations, comprised of 2,433 sequences of multi-spectral images of shape 10x128x128 covering over 4000 km2.
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot, Loic Landrieu
extraction.publisher: LASTIG, Univ. Gustave Eiffel, ENSG, IGN
extraction.citeAs: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot and Loic Landrieu. Panoptic Segmentation of Satellite Image Time Series with Convolutional Temporal Attention Networks. ICCV, 2021.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were gathered from THEIA using Copernicus data. Annotations were taken from the French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS) produced by IGN.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The time between acquisitions is uneven with a median of 5 days due to the automatic filtering of acquisitions with extensive cloud cover by the satellite data provider THEIA. Close to 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2 satellite images and the French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS).
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: No imputation was applied. The authors opted to not apply further pre-processing or cloud detection, reasoning that an adequate algorithm should be able to learn to deal with such acquisitions.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Parcels whose surface is more than 50% outside of the patch are annotated with the void label. Parcels belonging to classes not in the 18-classes nomenclature are annotated with the void label. Patches were selected favoring rare crop types to decrease class imbalance.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Atmospheric correction and re-sampling at a spatial resolution of 10 meters per pixel were performed by THEIA. The authors selected all bands except the atmospheric bands B01, B09, and B10.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations were taken from the publicly available French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS) as reported by the farmers. Each pixel is associated with a semantic label (18 crop types plus background) and a unique instance label corresponding to its parcel index.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The French Payment Agency estimates the accuracy of the crop annotations via in situ control over 98% and the relative error in terms of surfaces under 0.3%.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Remote monitoring of the surface and nature of agricultural parcels is necessary for a fair allocation of agricultural subsidies (50 and 22 billion euros per year in Europe and the US) and for ensuring that best crop rotation practices are respected.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is highly unbalanced, with a ratio of over 50 between the most and least common classes. Patches were selected favoring rare crop types to decrease the extreme class imbalance.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is highly unbalanced. Close to 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover. Ambiguous borders and hard-to-classify parcel content make panoptic segmentation difficult. Thin or visually fragmented parcels are often not recovered correctly.
